typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblConfirmsL2Data_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		parentMetricID as string,
		childMetricID as string,
		metricID as integer,
		metricOwner as string,
		Metric_Date as date,
		{Period Counter Week} as double,
		{Period Counter Month} as double,
		{Period Counter Quarter} as double,
		Year as double,
		Manager as string,
		Asset_Class as string,
		Type as string,
		Non_Electronic_PC as decimal(18,2),
		Non_Electronic_QTY as integer,
		Electronic_PC as decimal(18,2),
		Electronic_QTY as integer,
		Metric_Calc as decimal(11,4),
		Metric_Threshold as string,
		KeyField as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtbllvlTwoDetailConfirms	source(output(
		KeyField as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DuplicatePreventionLookupLKPTABLE
fromtbllvlTwoDetailConfirms derive({Copy of Metric_Calc} = Metric_Calc,
		{Copy of parentMetricID} = parentMetricID,
		{Copy of childMetricID} = childMetricID,
		{Copy of Type} = Type,
		{Copy of Metric_Date} = toString(Metric_Date),
		{Copy of Year} = Year,
		{Copy of Non_Electronic_QTY} = Non_Electronic_QTY,
		{Copy of Electronic_QTY} = Electronic_QTY,
		{Copy of KeyField} = KeyField,
		{Copy of Asset_Class} = Asset_Class,
		{Copy of Electronic_PC} = Electronic_PC,
		{Copy of Metric_Threshold} = Metric_Threshold,
		{Copy of Non_Electronic_PC} = Non_Electronic_PC,
		{Copy of Manager} = Manager,
		{Copy of metricID} = metricID,
		{Copy of metricOwner} = metricOwner) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,DuplicatePreventionLookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of KeyField} == DuplicatePreventionLookupLKPTABLE@KeyField,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> DuplicatePreventionLookup
DuplicatePreventionLookup select(mapColumn(
		{Copy of Asset_Class} = {Copy of Asset_Class},
		{Copy of childMetricID} = {Copy of childMetricID},
		{Copy of Electronic_PC} = {Copy of Electronic_PC},
		{Copy of Electronic_QTY} = {Copy of Electronic_QTY},
		{Copy of KeyField} = {Copy of KeyField},
		{Copy of Manager} = {Copy of Manager},
		{Copy of Metric_Calc} = {Copy of Metric_Calc},
		{Copy of Metric_Date} = {Copy of Metric_Date},
		{Copy of Metric_Threshold} = {Copy of Metric_Threshold},
		{Copy of metricID} = {Copy of metricID},
		{Copy of metricOwner} = {Copy of metricOwner},
		{Copy of Non_Electronic_PC} = {Copy of Non_Electronic_PC},
		{Copy of Non_Electronic_QTY} = {Copy of Non_Electronic_QTY},
		{Copy of parentMetricID} = {Copy of parentMetricID},
		{Copy of Period Counter Month} = {Copy of Period Counter Month},
		{Copy of Period Counter Quarter} = {Copy of Period Counter Quarter},
		{Copy of Period Counter Week} = {Copy of Period Counter Week},
		{Copy of Type} = {Copy of Type},
		{Copy of Year} = {Copy of Year},
		Metric_Calc = Metric_Calc,
		Electronic_QTY = Electronic_QTY,
		Non_Electronic_QTY = Non_Electronic_QTY,
		Non_Electronic_PC = Non_Electronic_PC,
		KeyField = DuplicatePreventionLookupLKPTABLE@KeyField,
		{Period Counter Week} = {Period Counter Week},
		{Period Counter Quarter} = {Period Counter Quarter},
		Manager = Manager,
		{Period Counter Month} = {Period Counter Month},
		metricOwner = metricOwner,
		Type = Type,
		childMetricID = childMetricID,
		metricID = metricID,
		Year = Year,
		Metric_Threshold = Metric_Threshold,
		Metric_Date = Metric_Date,
		parentMetricID = parentMetricID,
		Asset_Class = Asset_Class,
		Electronic_PC = Electronic_PC
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> DuplicatePreventionLookup01
DuplicatePreventionLookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> DuplicatePreventionLookup0
DuplicatePreventionLookup0 sink(input(
		Period_Counter_Week as string,
		Metric_Calc as string,
		Electronic_QTY as string,
		Non_Electronic_QTY as string,
		Non_Electronic_PC as string,
		KeyField as string,
		Manager as string,
		metricOwner as string,
		Type as string,
		childMetricID as string,
		metricID as string,
		Year as string,
		Metric_Threshold as string,
		Period_Counter_Quarter as string,
		Metric_Date as string,
		parentMetricID as string,
		Period_Counter_Month as string,
		Electronic_PC as string,
		Asset_Class as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Period_Counter_Week = {Period Counter Week},
		Metric_Calc,
		Electronic_QTY,
		Non_Electronic_QTY,
		Non_Electronic_PC,
		KeyField = {Copy of KeyField},
		Manager = {Copy of Manager},
		metricOwner,
		Type = {Copy of Type},
		childMetricID,
		metricID,
		Year,
		Metric_Threshold,
		Period_Counter_Quarter = {Period Counter Quarter},
		Metric_Date = {Copy of Metric_Date},
		parentMetricID,
		Period_Counter_Month = {Period Counter Month},
		Electronic_PC,
		Asset_Class = {Copy of Asset_Class}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblConfirmsL2Data_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblConfirmsL2Data
